author: visegrad24
text:
Swedish election result in 2026 if only Swedes and European migrants would have voted:

The right - 181 seats
The left - 168 seats

Actual Swedish election result 

The right - 173 seats
The left - 176 seats

The left wouldn’t have won the the election without non-Europeans
